decisions: Summary reads are path-addressed because the production check passes only a route answering 200 or 403.
Agent-artifact links keep their read: no event refreshes it and it never held an issue read.
Events gain only optional fields, no new type (an old tab refreshes everything on an unknown type); every rule falls back to today's breadth when its field is absent.
user_state.updated gets changed, not an issue key, so it does not broadcast which issue each person reads.
Status changes refresh the details named in ancestors; parent, components or repo changes refresh every active detail.
No two requests in flight covers every refetch, through a QueryClient subclass, not only event-driven ones; when a fetch outlasts a second the in-flight rule wins.
A resuming reconnect with a complete replay refreshes nothing, so tab focus does not refetch every query (needed for the production rate bar).
The production rate is the mean over 10 minutes per (caller, user agent); served times are informational, since the spec sets no threshold.
Memory measured with kubectl top (comment 8d3d6ac7) is not in the approved acceptance and the worker cannot run it (pods.metrics.k8s.io forbidden at planning); not planned, the architect decides.

specDepartures.spec: Acceptance 1: a browser test opens an issue page whose spec links 50 different issues and waits until every reference shows its title.
specDepartures.plan: The 50 links go in the issue's spec and in one message on it; the test opens the issue's Conversation tab, where the references render with titles.
specDepartures.evidence: The live spec editor keeps the author's link text and makes no per-reference read (packages/dispatch/e2e/doc.e2e.ts:672-678); RefLink reads happen only in rendered Markdown (packages/dispatch/web/src/features/refs/useRenderedMarkdown.tsx:105-126). With the links only in the spec, no reference shows a title and the base commit makes none of the ~1,000 requests, so the test could not fail there.

acceptance: Acceptance 1's page is the issue's Conversation tab holding the 50 links in a message; its numbers are unchanged.
